sloka: कस्य इमे निहता बाणाः प्रकीर्णा घोर दर्शनः ।शरावरौ शरैः पूर्णौ विध्वस्तौ पश्य लक्ष्मण ॥३-६४-४९॥
transliteration: kasya ime nihatā bāṇāḥ prakīrṇā ghora darśanaḥ ।śarāvarau śaraiḥ pūrṇau vidhvastau paśya lakṣmaṇa ॥3-64-49॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana look at these two quivers filled with arrows and lying shattered. The charioteer is holding a whip and reins in his hands and is lying dead. To whom do they belong?
